desc: Steam Deck co-op (its own controller, no touch): a second controller plugged in is nobody until its Start (the playtest: co-op turned itself on), then player 2 in port 2 with the Deck's staying player 1; player 2 walks and hops the partner, every hop back to standing (the playtest's partner stuck mid-jump); a seat swap asked in player 2's menu and said yes to on the Deck, then back; controller 2 switched off: one player again
